sync.description: Outcome of pulling the repository's newer commits into the app, or `null` unless `direction` is `github_to_base44`.

restricted.title: Restricted
restricted.description: Whether the app's workspace limits GitHub repositories to an approved list of organizations.

GithubOrgPolicyStatus.title: GithubOrgPolicyStatus
GithubOrgPolicyStatus.description: Whether the app's workspace limits which GitHub organizations it can use.

id.title: Id
id.description: Base44's ID for the account. Pass it as `account_id` on the other account endpoints.

account_name.title: Account Name
account_name.description: Name of the Google Ads account.

google_customer_id.title: Google Customer Id
google_customer_id.description: The account's customer ID in Google Ads. Empty until Google has provisioned it.

status.title: Status
status.description: State of the account. Either `ACTIVE`, `BLOCKED`, `SUSPENDED`, `BILLING_HOLD`, `CANCELED`, `PENDING_VERIFICATION`, `PENDING_BILLING_SETUP`, or `PENDING_CLOSE`. Only an `ACTIVE` account can create or resume campaigns.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: Currency the account bills in, as an ISO 4217 code.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Time zone the account reports in, as an IANA name.

budget_active.title: Budget Active
budget_active.description: Whether the account has a live Google Ads budget, which campaigns need in order to serve.

billing_cadence.title: Billing Cadence
billing_cadence.description: How often the account is charged: `3d`, `1w`, `2w`, or `1m`. Only drives charging when `charge_trigger_mode` is `cadence`.

charge_trigger_mode.title: Charge Trigger Mode
charge_trigger_mode.description: What triggers a charge on this account. A mode of `cadence` charges on the `billing_cadence` schedule, while `threshold` is a legacy mode that charges when spend crosses a ladder of thresholds and ignores `billing_cadence` entirely.

monthly_spend_cap_micros.title: Monthly Spend Cap Micros
monthly_spend_cap_micros.description: Monthly spend cap in micros of the account currency, so `500000000` is 500.00. The value is `0` when no cap is set.

auto_renew.title: Auto Renew
auto_renew.description: Whether the account's budget renews automatically at the end of its window.

budget_window_end.title: Budget Window End
budget_window_end.description: When the current budget window ends, or `null` before a budget exists.

terms_accepted_at.title: Terms Accepted At
terms_accepted_at.description: When the Google Ads terms were accepted for this account, or `null` until they are.

business_profile_location_id.title: Business Profile Location Id
business_profile_location_id.description: Google Business Profile location linked to the account, as `locations/<id>`. Empty when none is linked.

customer_grade.title: Customer Grade
customer_grade.description: How far the workspace has earned higher limits by paying on time. `0` until 3 invoices in a row are paid with no decline, then `1`, rising by one per further clean invoice. It never goes down; it reads `0` only while an account in the workspace is on hold or blocked.

active_campaign_limit.title: Active Campaign Limit
active_campaign_limit.description: How many of the account's campaigns can be enabled at once. `2`, plus one per `customer_grade`, up to `5`.

created_date.title: Created Date
created_date.description: When the account was created in Base44.

updated_date.title: Updated Date
updated_date.description: When Base44 last changed its record of the account.

GoogleAdsAccountResource.title: GoogleAdsAccountResource
GoogleAdsAccountResource.description: The account fields this API commits to.

headlines.title: Headlines
headlines.description: Suggested headlines, each within Google's 30-character limit.

descriptions.title: Descriptions
descriptions.description: Suggested description lines, each within Google's 90-character limit.
example: Solid oak dining tables built to order in San Francisco. Free delivery.

language.title: Language
language.description: Two-letter code for the language the copy came back in, or `null` when the model did not report one. Pass it as `settings.language_code` on [Create campaign](/api-reference/create-google-ads-campaign) so the campaign's language matches its copy.

source.title: Source
source.description: `ai` when a language model wrote this copy. Any other value means it did not, and you are looking at fallback text built from the business details you sent.

GoogleAdsAdCopy.title: GoogleAdsAdCopy
GoogleAdsAdCopy.description: Headlines and descriptions for a campaign's ads.

id.title: Id
id.description: Base44's ID for the campaign whose budget changed.

daily_budget_micros.title: Daily Budget Micros
daily_budget_micros.description: The campaign's daily budget after the change, in micros.

already_applied.title: Already Applied
already_applied.description: `true` when this recommendation had already been applied and nothing changed on this call, so a retry is safe. Absent when the call applied the change.

GoogleAdsAppliedBudgetRecommendation.title: GoogleAdsAppliedBudgetRecommendation
GoogleAdsAppliedBudgetRecommendation.description: The campaign's budget after applying Google's recommendation.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: The currency these amounts are in, upper-cased from what you sent.

campaign_type.title: Campaign Type
campaign_type.description: The campaign type these bounds apply to, upper-cased from what you sent.

min_daily_budget_micros.title: Min Daily Budget Micros
min_daily_budget_micros.description: Smallest daily budget Google accepts for this campaign type and currency, in micros (1,000,000 micros = 1 unit of the currency). Sending less than this to [Create campaign](/api-reference/create-google-ads-campaign) is rejected with a 400.

max_daily_budget_micros.title: Max Daily Budget Micros
max_daily_budget_micros.description: Largest daily budget accepted for this campaign type and currency, in micros.

recommended_daily_budget_micros.title: Recommended Daily Budget Micros
recommended_daily_budget_micros.description: A sensible starting daily budget, in micros. Never above `max_daily_budget_micros`.

preset_daily_budget_micros.title: Preset Daily Budget Micros
preset_daily_budget_micros.description: Three suggested daily budgets, in micros, from lowest to highest. These are raw presets, so unlike `recommended_daily_budget_micros` the highest one can sit above `max_daily_budget_micros`.

usd_to_currency_rate.title: Usd To Currency Rate
usd_to_currency_rate.description: How many units of this currency Base44 counts per US dollar when it converts the presets.

clicks_per_unit_min.title: Clicks Per Unit Min
clicks_per_unit_min.description: Low end of the clicks one unit of `currency_code` in daily budget has actually bought. Multiply a daily budget by this directly — it is already in the same currency the budget is, so no conversion is involved. Always present — check `clicks_per_unit_scope` to see whether it is a live measurement.

clicks_per_unit_max.title: Clicks Per Unit Max
clicks_per_unit_max.description: High end of the same range, with the same caveat: measured when `clicks_per_unit_scope` is `campaign` or `fleet`, a stored rate when it is `unavailable`.

clicks_per_unit_scope.title: Clicks Per Unit Scope
clicks_per_unit_scope.description: Where the click range came from, and whether it is a measurement at all. `campaign`: measured on the campaign named by `campaign_id`. `fleet`: measured across accounts billing in this currency — also what an unknown campaign, or one without enough delivery, returns. `unavailable`: NOT measured — a stored range is being served because this currency has too few accounts to measure or the measurement could not be read. The range is usable in every case, but only the first two are measured.

GoogleAdsBudgetBoundaries.title: GoogleAdsBudgetBoundaries
GoogleAdsBudgetBoundaries.description: The daily budget range Google accepts for a campaign type and currency.

estimated_daily_clicks_low.title: Estimated Daily Clicks Low
estimated_daily_clicks_low.description: Low end of Google's forecast daily clicks.

estimated_daily_clicks_high.title: Estimated Daily Clicks High
estimated_daily_clicks_high.description: High end of Google's forecast daily clicks.

estimated_monthly_cost.title: Estimated Monthly Cost
estimated_monthly_cost.description: Forecast spend over 30 days, in micros (1,000,000 micros = 1 unit of the account's currency). This is the recommended daily budget times 30, so it is a 30-day figure rather than a calendar month, and it can differ from the `daily_budget` you sent.

GoogleAdsBudgetEstimate.title: GoogleAdsBudgetEstimate
GoogleAdsBudgetEstimate.description: Google's forecast for a set of keyword themes in a set of locations.

impressions.title: Impressions
impressions.description: Times the campaign's ads were shown.

cost_micros.title: Cost Micros
cost_micros.description: Spend over the window, in micros (1,000,000 micros = 1 unit of the account's currency).

conversions.title: Conversions
conversions.description: Conversions Google attributed to the campaign.

ctr.title: Ctr
ctr.description: Click-through rate as a fraction, so `0.028` is 2.8%.

GoogleAdsCampaignMetrics.title: GoogleAdsCampaignMetrics
GoogleAdsCampaignMetrics.description: Performance figures for one campaign over the requested window.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: One entry per campaign, keyed by the Google Ads campaign ID. This is the `google_campaign_id` field from [List campaigns](/api-reference/list-google-ads-campaigns), not Base44's `id`, so join on that field. Campaigns with no activity in the window are left out entirely.

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: `true` when Google could not be reached and `metrics` is empty for that reason rather than because nothing ran. Always check this before showing zeros.

GoogleAdsCampaignMetricsResponse.title: GoogleAdsCampaignMetricsResponse
GoogleAdsCampaignMetricsResponse.description: Live metrics for every campaign on the account, keyed by Google's campaign ID.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable ID for the suggestion: `smart-traffic`, `smart-leads` or `pmax-leads`.

title.title: Title
title.description: One-line name for the approach. Always English, even when the copy in `payload` is in another language.

subtitle.title: Subtitle
subtitle.description: What this approach is best for. Always English, even when the copy in `payload` is in another language.
subtitle.example: Best for raising overall visits to the site

estimated_daily_clicks.title: Estimated Daily Clicks
estimated_daily_clicks.description: Rough daily clicks this approach could produce at the budget you sent. At least 1.

estimate_source.title: Estimate Source
estimate_source.description: Where `estimated_daily_clicks` came from. `planner_anchored` means it is scaled from Google's own forecast for this account. `heuristic` means Google was not consulted, because the app has no connected account yet or the forecast was unavailable, and the number is a rough calculation from the budget alone.

payload.description: The campaign body to send to [Create campaign](/api-reference/create-google-ads-campaign) to launch this suggestion.

GoogleAdsCampaignSuggestion.title: GoogleAdsCampaignSuggestion
GoogleAdsCampaignSuggestion.description: One suggested campaign the caller can preview and launch.

campaign_name.title: Campaign Name
campaign_name.description: Suggested campaign name, trimmed to 120 characters.

business_name.title: Business Name
business_name.description: The business name you sent, echoed back.

headlines.title: Headlines
headlines.description: Generated headlines for the campaign's ads.

descriptions.title: Descriptions
descriptions.description: Generated description lines for the campaign's ads.
example: Solid oak dining tables built to order in San Francisco.

keyword_themes.title: Keyword Themes
keyword_themes.description: Up to five generated keyword themes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Campaign settings to send on unchanged. Carries `language_code`, the language this suggestion's copy was written in, whenever the model reported one; empty otherwise. Drop it and the campaign is created targeting English while its copy is not.

logo_url.title: Logo Url
logo_url.description: Always empty. Performance Max campaigns need a logo to launch, so fill this in before you send the draft.

images.title: Images
images.description: Always empty. Performance Max campaigns need marketing images to launch, so fill these in before you send the draft, as image objects in the shape [Create campaign](/api-reference/create-google-ads-campaign) documents for `images`. Create rejects a bare URL string.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.description: The suggested campaigns, most general first. At most three, however many you asked for.

descriptions: Solid oak dining tables built to order.

example.subtitle: Best for raising overall visits to the site
example.title: Smart Search - drive traffic

language.title: Language
language.description: Two-letter code for the language the generated copy came back in, or `null` when the model did not report one.

source.title: Source
source.description: `ai` when a language model wrote the copy in these suggestions, `fallback` when it did not run or returned nothing.

GoogleAdsCampaignSuggestions.title: GoogleAdsCampaignSuggestions
GoogleAdsCampaignSuggestions.description: Suggested campaigns for a business description.

keyword_themes.title: Keyword Themes
keyword_themes.description: The themes the campaign matches on.

excluded_terms.title: Excluded Terms
excluded_terms.description: Search terms the campaign is told not to match.

language_code.title: Language Code
language_code.description: Two-letter code for the language the campaign advertises in. Defaults to `en` when the campaign has none set.

GoogleAdsCampaignTargeting.title: GoogleAdsCampaignTargeting
GoogleAdsCampaignTargeting.description: What a campaign currently targets, read live from Google.

enhanced_prompt.title: Enhanced Prompt
enhanced_prompt.description: The rewritten prompt. Empty when you sent an empty or whitespace-only `raw_prompt`, in which case no model runs and no quota is spent.
enhanced_prompt.example: A warm, sunlit photograph of a handmade oak dining table in a bright modern kitchen, shallow depth of field, lifestyle advertising photography

original_prompt.title: Original Prompt
original_prompt.description: The `raw_prompt` you sent, echoed back unchanged.

resource_name.title: Resource Name
resource_name.description: Google's identifier for the location. Pass it in `geo_targets` when you create a campaign.

name.title: Name
name.description: The location's own name.

canonical_name.title: Canonical Name
canonical_name.description: The location's full path, including its region and country.

country_code.title: Country Code
country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code the location sits in.

target_type.title: Target Type
target_type.description: What kind of place this is, for example `City`, `Region` or `Country`.

reach.title: Reach
reach.description: Google's estimate of how many people can be reached in this location.

search_term.title: Search Term
search_term.description: The `query` value this result was matched against, echoed back.

GoogleAdsGeoTarget.title: GoogleAdsGeoTarget
GoogleAdsGeoTarget.description: One location Google matched for the search string.

search_query.title: Search Query
search_query.description: A search someone might type to find this business.

description.title: Description
description.description: Body text of the sample ad.
description.example: Built to order in our San Francisco workshop. Free delivery statewide.

subtitle.title: Subtitle
subtitle.description: The display line shown under the headline, usually the site.

business_name.title: Business Name
business_name.description: The business name this preview was written for, taken from the app.

source.title: Source
source.description: `ai` when a language model wrote this preview, `fallback` when it did not run or returned nothing and Base44 filled in generic copy instead.

GoogleAdsHeroPreview.title: GoogleAdsHeroPreview
GoogleAdsHeroPreview.description: A sample search result to show before the app has a Google Ads account.

code.title: Code
code.description: Token to send as `coupon_code` to [Apply a Google Ads incentive](/api-reference/apply-a-google-ads-incentive). Treat it as opaque. It's bound to the currency the offer was quoted in.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: Currency of `reward_amount_micros` and `required_min_spend_micros`, as an ISO 4217 code. It's the account's currency, or the currency a new account would be created in when you left out `account_id`.

approximate.title: Approximate
approximate.description: Whether the amounts were converted from the currency Google quoted the offer in (`true`) or are Google's own figures (`false`). Google converts again at its own rate when it grants the reward, so a converted amount can differ slightly from the credit granted.

reward_amount_micros.title: Reward Amount Micros
reward_amount_micros.description: Ad credit Google grants once the spend requirement is met, in micros of `currency_code`, so `500000000` is 500.00.

required_min_spend_micros.title: Required Min Spend Micros
required_min_spend_micros.description: Ad spend the account has to reach to earn the reward, in micros of `currency_code`.

terms_url.title: Terms Url
terms_url.description: Google's terms and conditions for the offer. Empty when Google didn't return a link.

GoogleAdsIncentiveOffer.title: GoogleAdsIncentiveOffer
GoogleAdsIncentiveOffer.description: One promotional offer the app's Google Ads account can take.

invoice_date.title: Invoice Date
invoice_date.description: Date the invoice was issued, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

period_start.title: Period Start
period_start.description: First day the invoice covers, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

period_end.title: Period End
period_end.description: Last day the invoice covers, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

status.title: Status
status.description: State of the invoice. Either `PENDING`, `PAID`, `FAILED`, or `VOID`.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: Currency of every amount on the invoice, as an ISO 4217 code.

ad_spend_micros.title: Ad Spend Micros
ad_spend_micros.description: Ad spend for the period in micros, so `248000000` is 248.00.

service_fee_micros.title: Service Fee Micros
service_fee_micros.description: Base44's service fee for the period, in micros.

tax_micros.title: Tax Micros
tax_micros.description: Tax charged on the invoice, in micros.

total_micros.title: Total Micros
total_micros.description: Size of the invoice in micros, always positive. On a refund this is the magnitude refunded rather than an amount charged, so read `signed_total_micros` or `is_refund` before treating it as money owed.

is_refund.title: Is Refund
is_refund.description: Whether the row is a refund rather than a charge.

signed_total_micros.title: Signed Total Micros
signed_total_micros.description: The invoice total with its direction applied: positive on a charge, negative on a refund. Sum this rather than `total_micros` when you total an account's billing.

billing_type.title: Billing Type
billing_type.description: Why the invoice was raised: `weekly` on the billing cycle, `threshold` when spend crossed the cap, `reconciliation` to true up an earlier period.

GoogleAdsInvoiceSummary.title: GoogleAdsInvoiceSummary
GoogleAdsInvoiceSummary.description: One billing invoice for the app's Google Ads account.

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: Suggested themes for the campaign. Can be empty.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the themes came from. `google` means Google's own suggester. `generated` means a language model wrote them, which only happens for apps with that feature enabled. An empty `themes` list is always reported as `google`, including when the AI quota was spent or the campaign had too little detail to ask Google, so `google` with no themes does not mean Google returned nothing.

GoogleAdsKeywordThemeSuggestions.title: GoogleAdsKeywordThemeSuggestions
GoogleAdsKeywordThemeSuggestions.description: Suggested keyword themes for a campaign, and where they came from.

search_themes.title: Search Themes
search_themes.description: Up to 10 themes, each at most 80 characters. Pass them as `search_themes` when you create a Performance Max campaign. An empty list means the model returned nothing usable.

GoogleAdsSearchThemes.title: GoogleAdsSearchThemes
GoogleAdsSearchThemes.description: Short themes describing what a Performance Max campaign should match.

resourceName.title: Resourcename
resourceName.description: Google's identifier for the location, as returned by [Search locations](/api-reference/search-google-ads-locations). Note this field is camel-cased, unlike the rest of this API.

name.title: Name
name.description: The location's display name. Falls back to the numeric ID from `resourceName` when Base44 has no stored label for it, which happens for locations set before the label was recorded.

GoogleAdsTargetedLocation.title: GoogleAdsTargetedLocation
GoogleAdsTargetedLocation.description: One location a campaign targets or excludes.

HEADLINE.title: Headline
HEADLINE.description: Short headlines, each within Google's 30-character limit. Present only when you asked for `HEADLINE`.

LONG_HEADLINE.title: Long Headline
LONG_HEADLINE.description: Long headlines, each within Google's 90-character limit. Present only when you asked for `LONG_HEADLINE`.
example: Solid oak dining tables, built to order in San Francisco

DESCRIPTION.title: Description
DESCRIPTION.description: Description lines, each within Google's 90-character limit. Present only when you asked for `DESCRIPTION`.
example: Free statewide delivery on every table we build.

BUSINESS_NAME.title: Business Name
BUSINESS_NAME.description: A single business name, trimmed to Google's 25-character limit. This one is a string rather than an array, unlike every other asset type here. Present only when you asked for `BUSINESS_NAME`.

CALL_TO_ACTION_SELECTION.title: Call To Action Selection
CALL_TO_ACTION_SELECTION.description: Call-to-action values Google accepts. This is a fixed list, not a generated one. Present only when you asked for `CALL_TO_ACTION_SELECTION`.

GoogleAdsTextAssets.title: GoogleAdsTextAssets
GoogleAdsTextAssets.description: Suggested text for each asset type you asked for.

path.title: Path
path.description: File the match is in, relative to the app root. `null` on a match line Base44 couldn't split into path, line and text, where the whole line lands in `text` instead.

line.title: Line
line.description: 1-based line number of the match, and `null` in the same case `path` is.

text.title: Text
text.description: The matching line. Always populated, so it's the field to fall back on.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: `true` when there was more to return: either more matches than `max_results`, or output that hit the 1 MB cap. One very long line can set this with few matches.

GrepResult.title: GrepResult
GrepResult.description: The matches, and whether you got all of them.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email of the member.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: ID of the member's Base44 user.

full_name.title: Full Name
full_name.description: Member's name, or `null` when none is set.

profile_image_url.title: Profile Image Url
profile_image_url.description: URL of the member's profile image, or `null` when none is set.

members.title: Members
members.description: Members on this page, sorted by email.

total.title: Total
total.description: Number of members that match `search`, across all pages.

has_more.title: Has More
has_more.description: Whether more members follow this page.

event_name.title: Event Name
event_name.description: Name of the event to aggregate. Omit to aggregate every event the app tracks.

start_time.title: Start Time
start_time.description: Start of the time range, as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Defaults to 30 days ago.

end_time.title: End Time
end_time.description: End of the time range, as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Defaults to now.

max_groups.title: Max Groups
max_groups.description: Maximum number of groups to return per metric, between 1 and 1000. The largest groups are kept.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Between 1 and 10 metrics to compute. Each one must set `field`, which is the field it groups by. Defaults to an event count per event name, named `event_count`.

event_name.title: Event Name
event_name.description: The event name that was aggregated, or `null` when the request covered every event.

group_count.title: Group Count
group_count.description: Number of entries in `groups`, summed across every metric.

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: Each metric computed over the whole range without grouping, keyed by metric name.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: One entry per group value per metric, largest metric value first within each metric.

GroupedAggregationResponse.title: GroupedAggregationResponse
GroupedAggregationResponse.description: Analytics events aggregated by the value of a field.

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: The finding's `fingerprint`, as returned by [Get security scan](/api-reference/get-security-scan). Up to 128 characters.

finding_type.title: Finding Type
finding_type.description: Which list in [Get security scan](/api-reference/get-security-scan) the finding came from. Send `rls` for `rls_recommendations`, `secret` for `hardcoded_secrets`, `backend_function` for `backend_functions`, `dependency` for `dependency_vulnerabilities`, or `static_code` for `static_code_findings`. Any other value is accepted and nothing is recorded.

file_path.title: File Path
file_path.description: Path of the file the finding points at, kept with the ignore as a record of what was ignored. Up to 1,024 characters. Defaults to an empty string.

title.title: Title
title.description: Short name for the finding, kept with the ignore as a record of what was ignored. Up to 2,000 characters. Defaults to an empty string.
title.example: Order lookup trusts a client-supplied ID

branch_name.title: Branch Name
branch_name.description: Name of the branch to import, as it exists in the connected repository. Can't be the repository's default branch.

ImportBranchRequest.title: ImportBranchRequest
ImportBranchRequest.description: Request to import a branch that already exists in the connected repository.

id.title: Id
id.description: ID of the new Base44 branch.

branch_name.title: Branch Name
branch_name.description: The GitHub branch name, stored exactly as you sent it. Base44's own commits go to this same branch.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: ID of the branch's own conversation with the AI. The branch's chat history is separate from the app's main chat.

base_git_commit_hash.title: Base Git Commit Hash
base_git_commit_hash.description: Commit where the branch forked off the repository's default branch.

last_git_commit_hash.title: Last Git Commit Hash
last_git_commit_hash.description: Head commit of the GitHub branch at the moment it was imported.

created_date.title: Created Date
created_date.description: When the branch was created, in `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ` format (UTC).

ImportedBranchSummary.title: ImportedBranchSummary
ImportedBranchSummary.description: The Base44 branch created from an existing GitHub branch.

integration_type.title: Integration Type
integration_type.description: Connector to connect through Base44's OAuth app, from `integration_type` in [List connectors](/api-reference/list-connectors). Send this or `connector_id`, not both.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: OAuth scopes to ask the provider for. Scopes the app's current connection already has are kept unless `force_reconnect` is `true`. Defaults to an empty list, which asks for the connector's default scopes.

force_reconnect.title: Force Reconnect
force_reconnect.description: Whether to start a new authorization even when the app already has a working connection that covers the scopes. Send `true` to switch to another account. Applies only with `integration_type`. Defaults to `false`.

connection_config.title: Connection Config
connection_config.description: Values the connector needs before authorization, keyed by the `name` of each field from [Get connector connection fields](/api-reference/get-connector-connection-fields). Leave it out for connectors that have no fields.

connector_id.title: Connector Id
connector_id.description: ID of a workspace connector that uses the workspace's own OAuth app, set up in the workspace settings. Send this or `integration_type`, not both.

notify_chat_on_success.title: Notify Chat On Success
notify_chat_on_success.description: Whether a successful connection adds a message to the app's AI chat so the AI picks up wiring the connector into the app. Applies only with `integration_type`. Defaults to `false`.

redirect_url.title: Redirect Url
redirect_url.description: Link to open in a browser so the user can sign in to the provider and approve access. It expires after 10 minutes. Treat it as a credential. The value is `null` when no authorization was started.

connection_id.title: Connection Id
connection_id.description: ID of the connection being authorized. Pass it to [Get connector connection status](/api-reference/get-connector-connection-status). When `already_authorized` is `true` it's the existing connection, or `null` if you sent `connector_id`. The value is `null` when `error` is set.

integration_type.title: Integration Type
integration_type.description: Connector being connected. Without `connector_id`, the value is `null` when `already_authorized` is `true` or `error` is set.

already_authorized.title: Already Authorized
already_authorized.description: Whether the app already has a working connection that covers the requested scopes (`true`), so there's nothing to open, or not (`false`).

error.title: Error
error.description: Why no authorization was started, or `null` if one was. Either `different_user`, when another collaborator's account is already connected (with `integration_type`, send `force_reconnect` to replace it), or `service_unavailable`, when the provider can't be reached. Retry later.

error_message.title: Error Message
error_message.description: Readable explanation of `error`, or `null` when `error` is `null`.
error_message.example: Integration googlecalendar is already authorized by a different user for this app.

InitiateConnectionResponse.title: InitiateConnectionResponse
InitiateConnectionResponse.description: The start of a connector authorization, or why none was needed.

new_owner_email.title: New Owner Email
new_owner_email.description: Email address of the new owner. The invitation goes there, and they need a Base44 account with this email to accept it.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Either `same_workspace`, to invite an owner, admin, editor, or member of the app's workspace, or `external_email`, to invite anyone. Defaults to `external_email`.

disconnect_integrations.title: Disconnect Integrations
disconnect_integrations.description: Whether to disconnect all of the app's integrations when the recipient accepts into another workspace (`true`) or keep them connected (`false`). It's used only when you send neither `integration_decisions` nor `secret_decisions`, and has no effect when the recipient accepts into the app's current workspace. To disconnect integrations in that case, send `integration_decisions`. Defaults to `true`.

integration_decisions.title: Integration Decisions
integration_decisions.description: What happens to each of the app's integrations when the recipient accepts. An integration you leave out is disconnected, and so is one whose `can_keep_connected` is `false`, whatever you choose. If you send `secret_decisions` without this, it counts as empty, which is rejected when the app has integrations.

secret_decisions.title: Secret Decisions
secret_decisions.description: What happens to each of the app's secrets when the recipient accepts. A secret you leave out needs a new value. Values never go in the request, and are copied on the server. If you send `integration_decisions` without this, it counts as empty, which is rejected when the app has secrets. When you send neither list, every secret keeps its value.

keep_sender_as_collaborator.title: Keep Sender As Collaborator
keep_sender_as_collaborator.description: Whether the app's current owner keeps editor access to the app after the transfer (`true`) or loses their direct access to it (`false`). An owner or admin of the workspace the app ends up in keeps access through that workspace either way. Defaults to `false`.

InitiateTransferRequest.title: InitiateTransferRequest
InitiateTransferRequest.description: The ownership transfer invitation to send.

success.title: Success
success.description: Always `true`. Dismissing an already-dismissed suggestion succeeds the same way.

InsightDismissResponse.title: InsightDismissResponse
InsightDismissResponse.description: Confirmation that the suggestion is hidden.

already_installed.title: Already Installed
already_installed.description: Whether an existing usable installation was reused. Defaults to `false`.

claim_url.title: Claim Url
claim_url.description: Stripe onboarding link, or `null` when no claim step is available. Treat this link as a credential. Defaults to `null`.

auth_method.title: Auth Method
auth_method.description: How the connector authenticates. Either `oauth`, for a provider account someone signed in with, or `platform_credentials`, for a connector that runs on Base44's own credentials.

user_email.title: User Email
user_email.description: Email of the collaborator who made the connection. It's `Base44` for a `platform_credentials` connector on Base44's credentials and `null` for one on the app's own credentials. It's `Unknown` when the account no longer exists, and can be `null` when another collaborator made the connection.

integration_account_identifier.title: Integration Account Identifier
integration_account_identifier.description: The provider account that's connected, such as its email or username. The value is `null` when the provider doesn't report one, the connection isn't active, or another collaborator made the connection.

status.description: State of the connection. One of `active`, `expired` (it needs to be authorized again), or `disconnected`.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the connection was authorized, as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format, or `null` if unknown.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: OAuth scopes the connection was granted.

requires_connection_config.title: Requires Connection Config
requires_connection_config.description: Whether reconnecting needs values from [Get connector connection fields](/api-reference/get-connector-connection-fields) (`true`) or not (`false`).

connected_by_me.title: Connected By Me
connected_by_me.description: Whether you made the connection (`true`) or another collaborator did (`false`).

connection_id.title: Connection Id
connection_id.description: ID of the underlying connection, or `null` for a disconnected one or a `platform_credentials` connector on Base44's credentials.

connection_ownership.title: Connection Ownership
connection_ownership.description: Who owns the connection. Either `app`, for a connection only this app uses, or `workspace`, for one shared by apps across the workspace. The value is `null` for a `platform_credentials` connector on Base44's credentials.

status.description: State of the authorization. `PENDING` while it's still in progress, `ACTIVE` once the connection is ready to use, or `FAILED` if it was refused, expired, or couldn't be completed.

status_reason.title: Status Reason
status_reason.description: Why the authorization failed, when `status` is `FAILED` and you started it. The value is `null` otherwise.

IntegrationStatus.title: IntegrationStatus
IntegrationStatus.description: Enum for integration status values in the database.

integration_type.title: Integration Type
integration_type.description: Integration type, from `transfer_package.integrations` in the preflight result.

action.title: Action
action.description: Either `keep_connected`, to leave the integration connected for the new owner, or `disconnect`.

IntegrationTransferDecisionRequest.title: IntegrationTransferDecisionRequest
IntegrationTransferDecisionRequest.description: Sender decision for one app integration.

integration_type.title: Integration Type
integration_type.description: ID of the connector. Use it as `integration_type` on the app connector endpoints.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the connector gives an app access to.
description.example: Access and manage Google Calendar events

auth_method.title: Auth Method
auth_method.description: How the connector authenticates. Either `oauth`, where someone signs in to the provider, or `platform_credentials`, where it runs on Base44's own credentials and has no authorization to start.

connection_config_fields.title: Connection Config Fields
connection_config_fields.description: Values to collect before authorization, sent as `connection_config`. Empty for most connectors.

connector_mode.description: Which ways the connector can be connected. `all` and `shared_only` connect through Base44's OAuth app with `integration_type`. `byo_shared_only` and `byo_shared_and_app_user` need a workspace connector with the workspace's own OAuth app, sent as `connector_id`. `app_user_only`, `all`, and `byo_shared_and_app_user` also let each of the app's users connect their own account.

subtitle.title: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Short tagline, or `null` if the connector has none.
subtitle.example: Manage your schedule and calendar events.

category.title: Category
category.description: Group the connector is listed under.

display_status.title: Display Status
display_status.description: Release stage of the connector. One of `active`, `beta`, or `coming_soon`.

icon_svg.title: Icon Svg
icon_svg.description: The connector's logo as inline SVG markup, or `null` if it has none.

release_date.title: Release Date
release_date.description: When the connector was released, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format, or `null` if unknown.

popularity.title: Popularity
popularity.description: Ranking hint where a lower number is more prominent, starting at 1. `0` means the connector has no rank.

catalog_order.title: Catalog Order
catalog_order.description: Position in the catalog, or `null` for connectors listed after the ordered ones.

example_scopes.title: Example Scopes
example_scopes.description: Scopes an app typically asks for.

access_modes.description: Scope sets for read-only and full access, or `null` if the connector doesn't offer the choice.

example_prompts.title: Example Prompts
example_prompts.description: Sample requests to the app's AI chat that use the connector.
example: Sync all my bookings directly to my Google Calendar.

is_public_client.title: Is Public Client
is_public_client.description: Whether the provider's OAuth app authenticates with a client ID alone (`true`), so a workspace connector needs no client secret, or also needs a secret (`false`).

supports_base44_app_user.title: Supports Base44 App User
supports_base44_app_user.description: Whether the app's users can connect their own accounts through Base44's OAuth app (`true`) or only through the workspace's own (`false`).

base44_app_user_allowed_scopes.title: Base44 App User Allowed Scopes
base44_app_user_allowed_scopes.description: Scopes Base44's OAuth app can grant the app's users, or `null` when it sets no limit.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email of the person to invite.

role.description: Role the invitee gets when they accept. Defaults to `viewer`. `admin` needs the Business plan or higher.

group_id.title: Group Id
group_id.description: ID of a custom group to add the invitee to when they accept. Get it from [List workspace groups](/api-reference/list-workspace-groups). Needs a plan that includes groups.

InviteMemberRequest.title: InviteMemberRequest
InviteMemberRequest.description: An invitation to join a workspace.

email.title: Email
email.description: The address, as you sent it.

success.title: Success
success.description: Whether the invitation was sent.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the invitation wasn't sent. Only present when `success` is `false`.
error.example: User is not a member of this workspace.

error_code.title: Error Code
error_code.description: `not_workspace_member` when an editor invitation went to someone outside the app's workspace. Send it again with `add_as_guest` set to add them. Absent for every other failure.

has_pending_invitation.title: Has Pending Invitation
has_pending_invitation.description: Whether that person already has an invitation to the workspace waiting. Only present with `not_workspace_member`.

results.title: Results
results.description: One entry per address you sent.

InviteUsersResponse.title: InviteUsersResponse
InviteUsersResponse.description: The outcome of each invitation, in the order you sent them.

entity_name.title: Entity Name
entity_name.description: Name of the app entity this markup describes.

schema_type.title: Schema Type
schema_type.description: The Schema.org type Base44 matched the entity to.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How sure the match is, 0 to 1. Base44 leaves out any entity below 0.2.

json_ld_template.title: Json Ld Template
json_ld_template.description: The JSON-LD Base44 would inject, with `{field}` placeholders naming the entity fields that fill it. Written verbatim into the page, so the placeholders are not substituted per record.

field_mapping.title: Field Mapping
field_mapping.description: Which entity field fills each Schema.org property, keyed by property.

JsonLdEntity.title: JsonLdEntity
JsonLdEntity.description: One entity Base44 can describe with Schema.org markup.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: One entry per entity Base44 could match to a Schema.org type. Empty when none of the app's entities match one confidently.

JsonLdPreview.title: JsonLdPreview
JsonLdPreview.description: The Schema.org markup Base44 would publish for this app.

builder_prompt.title: Builder Prompt
builder_prompt.description: Prompt for the app builder that adds the missing analytics event. Present only while the app doesn't record `metric.event_name` yet.
builder_prompt.example: Track a lead_created event when a lead is saved on the Leads page.

where.title: Where
where.description: Where in the app's code the outcome already happens. Omitted when the agent didn't find it.

requested_at.title: Requested At
requested_at.description: When the build that adds the event was requested, as an ISO 8601 timestamp, or `null` if it hasn't been.

template.title: Template
template.description: How the KPI is counted. Either `"event_count"`, `"unique_sessions"`, `"unique_users"`, or `"retention_dn"`.

event_name.title: Event Name
event_name.description: Analytics event the KPI is measured against.

window_days.title: Window Days
window_days.description: Number of days the value is counted over. Either `7` or `30`.

n.title: N
n.description: Day the return is measured at, for a `retention_dn` KPI only.

result.description: The app's most recent scan, or `null` if it has never been scanned.

app_id.title: App Id
app_id.description: ID of the app.

flow_id.title: Flow Id
flow_id.description: ID of the test this run belongs to.

flow_goal.title: Flow Goal
flow_goal.description: The test's goal when the run started.
flow_goal.example: Sign up, create a project called Launch, and check that it appears on the dashboard.

flow_role.title: Flow Role
flow_role.description: Role the run signs in as, including one Base44 picked from the test's name or goal. Set once the run starts. `null` when the run uses no role.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where the run is. `pending`, `running` and `analyzing` mean it's still going. `success` means the browser session finished, and `failed` means it didn't. `timeout`, `cancelled` and `paused` mean the run stopped early. The test passed when `goal_accomplished` is `true` and `failure_reason` isn't `platform` or `internal`.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Steps the agent took. Empty until the run finishes.

example.step_summary: Clicked Sign up in the header to reach the registration form.

result_message.title: Result Message
result_message.description: The agent's account of how the run went, or `null` before the run finishes.
result_message.example: Created the project and found it on the dashboard.

goal_accomplished.title: Goal Accomplished
goal_accomplished.description: Whether the agent accomplished the goal, or `null` before the run finishes. Can be `true` on a run whose `failure_reason` is `platform` or `internal`, which counts as a technical failure.

live_status.title: Live Status
live_status.description: Short progress message for display, or `null` before the run starts.

analysis_status.title: Analysis Status
analysis_status.description: Progress of the run's report. `completed` means [Get test run report](/api-reference/get-test-run-report) has it. `null` before the run reaches analysis.

failure_reason.title: Failure Reason
failure_reason.description: Why the run didn't pass, or `null` when no reason was recorded. `app` is a problem in your app. `platform` and `internal` are problems on Base44's side, so rerun the test. `out_of_credits` comes with status `paused`.

credits_charged.title: Credits Charged
credits_charged.description: Credits the run cost, or `null` before it's charged.

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: When the browser session started, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, or `null` while pending.

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: When the run ended, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, or `null` while it's still going.

created_date.title: Created Date
created_date.description: When the run was requested, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

updated_date.title: Updated Date
updated_date.description: When the run last changed, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

analysis.description: The run's report, the same one [Get test run report](/api-reference/get-test-run-report) returns, or `null` while the run has none.

LatestTestRun.title: LatestTestRun
LatestTestRun.description: A test's most recent run, with its report.

LatestTestRuns.title: LatestTestRuns
LatestTestRuns.description: Each test's most recent run, keyed by the test's ID.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where the account stands: `ACTIVE` once it can spend, `PENDING_BILLING_SETUP` while Base44 is still wiring its billing.

account_name.title: Account Name
account_name.description: Name Base44 gave the account on Google, taken from the business details.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: Currency the account is billed in. Fixed when the account is created and never changes.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Time zone the account reports its days in. Also fixed at creation.

google_customer_id.title: Google Customer Id
google_customer_id.description: The account's Google Ads customer ID. Empty for the moment between Base44 reserving the account and Google returning its ID.

LaunchAccountSummary.title: LaunchAccountSummary
LaunchAccountSummary.description: The Google Ads account the campaign now lives on.

name.title: Name
name.description: Business name. Base44 falls back to the app's name when this is empty.

category.title: Category
category.description: Business category, empty when none is saved.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the business does, empty when none is saved.
description.example: Handmade oak furniture, delivered across Germany.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Contact phone number, empty when none is saved.

LaunchBusinessInfo.title: LaunchBusinessInfo
LaunchBusinessInfo.description: The business details Base44 will put on the Google Ads account.

has_payment_method.title: Has Payment Method
has_payment_method.description: Whether the workspace has a card on file. Launching without one is rejected with a 402.

stripe_unavailable.title: Stripe Unavailable
stripe_unavailable.description: `true` when Base44 could not reach its payment provider, so `has_payment_method` is not trustworthy. Launching in this state is rejected rather than allowed through.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: Currency the campaign will be billed in. On an account that already exists this is the currency it was created with and cannot change. Otherwise Base44 derives it from where the request comes from, not from how the workspace pays.

account_exists.title: Account Exists
account_exists.description: Whether the app already has a Google Ads account. When `false`, launching creates one, which cannot be undone.

account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: ID of that account, empty when there is none yet.

billing_cadence.title: Billing Cadence
billing_cadence.description: How often the campaign will be charged once launched: `3d`, `1w`, `2w`, or `1m`. Answered before the account exists so the billing terms shown at launch match how the account is actually charged.

landing_page_ready.title: Landing Page Ready
landing_page_ready.description: Whether Base44 resolved a page Google can actually crawl. Launching without one gets the campaign rejected by Google after the account already exists.

landing_page.title: Landing Page
landing_page.description: The exact URL to send as the campaign's `landing_page`: a live custom domain if the app has one, otherwise its published address. Empty when neither resolves. Send this rather than building the URL yourself.

business_info.description: The business details that will go on the Google Ads account. `null` when the app has none saved, in which case Base44 uses the app's name.

LaunchReadinessResponse.title: LaunchReadinessResponse
LaunchReadinessResponse.description:
Everything that decides whether a launch will succeed.

Omits `payment_method_last4` and `payment_method_brand`, which the response
also carries. Card detail is not something this endpoint needs to publish to
answer "can this launch"; `has_payment_method` is. Both fields keep being
sent, so leaving them undocumented changes no API.

account.description: The Google Ads account the campaign was created on, whether it already existed or was created by this call.

campaign.description: The campaign that is now live.

LaunchResponse.title: LaunchResponse
LaunchResponse.description: The account and the campaign, after both exist.

operation_id.title: Operation Id
operation_id.description: ID of this entity's part of the restore, as `operation_id` in Get data restore status.

id.title: Id
id.description: Base44's ID for the library row.

session_asset_id.title: Session Asset Id
session_asset_id.description: ID the asset was generated under. Pass it as `session_asset_id` to [Accept a generated Google Ads asset](/api-reference/accept-a-generated-google-ads-asset), which works from the library long after the generation session has expired.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: The generation session the asset came from. Empty on a row written before Base44 recorded it.

asset_field_type.title: Asset Field Type
asset_field_type.description: Which slot on the ad this asset fills. Text assets are `HEADLINE`, `LONG_HEADLINE` or `DESCRIPTION`. Image assets are `MARKETING_IMAGE`, `SQUARE_MARKETING_IMAGE`, `PORTRAIT_MARKETING_IMAGE` or `TALL_PORTRAIT_MARKETING_IMAGE`.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Whether the asset is copy (`text`) or a picture (`image`).

text.title: Text
text.description: The generated copy, or `null` on an image asset.
text.example: Handmade oak furniture, built to last

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: URL of the generated picture, or `null` on a text asset. Unlike the session copy this one is durable, which is what makes the library worth reading.

source.title: Source
source.description: Which engine wrote it. The value is `google` for Google's own asset generation and `inhouse` for the Base44 model that covers languages Google does not generate for, and that stands in when Google's call fails.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of a text asset as a lowercase two-letter code, or `null` on an image, because image assets carry no copy.

channel_type.title: Channel Type
channel_type.description: Campaign type the asset was generated for, one of `SEARCH`, `PERFORMANCE_MAX`, `DISPLAY` or `DEMAND_GEN`.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether the asset has been pushed to Google Ads. The value is `generated` until you accept it and `accepted` afterwards.

accepted_campaign_id.title: Accepted Campaign Id
accepted_campaign_id.description: The campaign the asset was accepted onto, as **Google Ads'** campaign ID rather than the Base44 `campaign_id` you sent to accept it. Match it against `google_campaign_id` from [List campaigns](/api-reference/list-google-ads-campaigns), not against `id`. Empty while `status` is `generated`.

accepted_resource_names.title: Accepted Resource Names
accepted_resource_names.description: Google Ads resource names created when the asset was accepted. Empty while `status` is `generated`, and empty on an accept where Google returned no resource name.

created_date.title: Created Date
created_date.description: When the asset was generated.

updated_date.title: Updated Date
updated_date.description: When the row last changed, which is the accept time on an accepted asset.

LibraryAssetSummary.title: LibraryAssetSummary
LibraryAssetSummary.description: One generated asset in the app's durable library.

ListConversationUsersResponse.title: ListConversationUsersResponse
ListConversationUsersResponse.description: A page of the app users who have conversations with the app's agents.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Files and directories, capped at 1000 entries.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: `true` when the listing hit the 1000-entry cap. Narrow it with `path` or a smaller `max_depth`.

ListDirectoryResult.title: ListDirectoryResult
ListDirectoryResult.description: The listing, and whether you got all of it.

email_domains.title: Email Domains
email_domains.description: The app's email domains. Usually one, empty when none are set up, and two while a replacement is in flight.

ListEmailDomainsResponse.title: ListEmailDomainsResponse
ListEmailDomainsResponse.description: Response for listing email domains for an app.

ListEntitySchemasResponse.title: ListEntitySchemasResponse
ListEntitySchemasResponse.description: Every entity the app defines, with its schema.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Every connector available to you. Sort by `catalog_order` to list them the way Base44 does.

example.description: Access and manage Google Calendar events

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: One entry per connector the app has a connection for.

new.title: New
new.description: Value after the update is approved.

ListingFieldChange.title: ListingFieldChange
ListingFieldChange.description: One listing detail that changes when the update is approved.

content.title: Content
content.description: The full file, ready to serve. Base44 generates it from the app's name, description and discovered routes, so it changes as the app does.
content.example:
# Acme CRM

> Track leads and deals in one place.

## Pages

- [Home](https://acme-crm.base44.app/): Main page
- [Pricing](https://acme-crm.base44.app/pricing): Pricing page

LlmsTxtPreview.title: LlmsTxtPreview
LlmsTxtPreview.description: The llms.txt Base44 would publish for this app.

logo_url.title: Logo Url
logo_url.description: Public URL of the generated logo image.

protected.title: Protected
protected.description: Whether the app's main branch is protected. While it is, changes to main have to go through a branch that you merge back.

created.title: Created
created.description: Whether a checkpoint was saved. `false` means the app has not changed since its most recent checkpoint, so there was nothing to save.

checkpoint_id.title: Checkpoint Id
checkpoint_id.description: ID of the checkpoint that was saved, or `null` when `created` is `false`. Pass it as `checkpoint_id` to [Deploy an app](/api-reference/deploy-an-app) to publish this version, or as `checkpoint_id` to [Restore checkpoint](/api-reference/restore-checkpoint) to return to it.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why nothing was saved. `no_changes` is the only value, and it is `null` when `created` is `true`.

status.title: Status
status.description: State of the latest run. Either `"idle"` before any run, `"provisioning"` while the workspace's Marketing Agent is created, `"analyzing"` while a run is working, `"ready"` once it finished, or `"error"` if it failed. A run that stops reporting for 15 minutes reads as `"error"`.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: ID of the latest run, or `null` if no run has started. Compare it between polls to tell a new run from the one you started.

last_error.title: Last Error
last_error.description: Why the latest run failed, or `null` if it didn't.
last_error.example: The scan did not complete. Retry the setup.

setup_stage.title: Setup Stage
setup_stage.description: How far setup has got. Either `"not_started"`, `"scanning"`, `"channels"`, `"kpis"`, `"budget"`, `"generating"`, or `"complete"`. At `channels`, `kpis`, and `budget` the agent is waiting for an answer.

reset_epoch.title: Reset Epoch
reset_epoch.description: Number of times the plan was reset. Send it back as `reset_epoch` when you answer a setup step.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: The marketing channels the agent proposed. Empty until the opening scan finishes.

channels_revision_suggestion.title: Channels Revision Suggestion
channels_revision_suggestion.description: A change to the channels the agent offers to make, or `null` if it offers none. Send it as a message to accept it.

kpis.title: Kpis
kpis.description: The KPIs the agent proposed. Empty until the opening scan finishes.

kpis_revision_suggestion.title: Kpis Revision Suggestion
kpis_revision_suggestion.description: A change to the KPIs the agent offers to make, or `null` if it offers none. Send it as a message to accept it.

strategy.description: The marketing strategy, or `null` until setup writes one.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.description: Growth ideas the agent generated for the app.

budget.description: The marketing budget given during setup, or `null` if none was given yet.

competitor_research_opt_in.title: Competitor Research Opt In
competitor_research_opt_in.description: Whether competitor research runs alongside the strategy.

competitor_research_answer.title: Competitor Research Answer
competitor_research_answer.description: Whether competitor research was accepted (`true`) or declined (`false`), or `null` if the question wasn't answered yet.

setup_paused.title: Setup Paused

competitors.title: Competitors
competitors.description: Competitors found by the research, with verified URLs.

competitor_scan_status.title: Competitor Scan Status
competitor_scan_status.description: State of the competitor research. Either `"running"`, `"done"`, or `"failed"`, or `null` if it never ran.

cmo_agent_app_id.title: Cmo Agent App Id
cmo_agent_app_id.description: ID of the workspace's Marketing Agent app your conversation runs on, or `null` if you haven't talked to it on this app yet.

description.title: Description
description.description: The budget as it was stated.

band.title: Band
band.description: Budget band that selects each KPI's target. Either `"none"`, `"low"`, `"mid"`, or `"high"`. Omitted when the budget was stated in free text.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the channel.

why.title: Why
why.description: Why this channel fits the app.

tactics.title: Tactics
tactics.description: Concrete tactics for the channel. Up to 3.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: How much to invest in this channel, from `1` to `5`, where `5` means invest here first. Omitted when the agent didn't rank it.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the competitor.

angle.title: Angle

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: What the competitor leaves open for this app.

name.title: Name
name.description: The KPI in one measurable line.

why.title: Why

baseline.title: Baseline

target.title: Target
target.description: Target at the recommended budget, with a time horizon.

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: The target at each budget band, keyed by `none`, `low`, `mid`, and `high`. A band that's missing means spend at that level can't move this KPI.

target_values.title: Target Values
target_values.description: The number inside each band's target, keyed like `targets`.

metric.description: How the KPI is measured against the app's analytics. Omitted on KPIs created before measurement was added.

instrument.description: How to start recording the KPI's event. Omitted when the app already records it.

summary.title: Summary

positioning.title: Positioning

channel_plan.title: Channel Plan

key_metrics.description: The metrics the strategy is judged by.

budget_fit.title: Budget Fit

MembersDateRangeFilter.description: Inclusive bounds on a time. Set either bound, or both.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

total.title: Total
total.description: Number of people matching the filters, across all pages.

monthly_limit.title: Monthly Limit
monthly_limit.description: The workspace's monthly credits, or `null` when they're unlimited.

default_member_credit_limit.title: Default Member Credit Limit
default_member_credit_limit.description: The workspace's default member credit limit, or `null` when none is set.

search.title: Search
search.description: Text to match, ignoring case, anywhere in a member's email, name, role, or status.

search_terms.title: Search Terms
search_terms.description: More text to match the same way as `search`, up to 200 terms. A member matches when any term does.

sort_by.title: Sort By
sort_by.description: Column to sort by: `member` (name, or email when there's no name), `credits` (`credits_used`), `apps` and `agents` (owned plus shared), `last_active`, or `role` (owner, admin, editor, viewer, guest). Needs `sort_dir`.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Only members with one of these roles: `owner`, `admin`, `editor`, `viewer`, or `guest`.

invite_statuses.title: Invite Statuses
invite_statuses.description: Only people in one of these states: `joined`, `pending` (invited and not yet joined), or `expired` (the invitation lapsed).

credit_limit_set.title: Credit Limit Set
credit_limit_set.description: `true` for only members with their own credit limit, `false` for only members without one. A member on the workspace default counts as not having their own.

apps_owned.description: Only members whose `apps_owned` plus `apps_shared` is in this range.

agents_owned.description: Only members whose `agents_owned` plus `agents_shared` is in this range.

last_active.description: Only members whose `last_active` is in this range. Members who never used credits don't match.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page. Leave it out for the first page.

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: How many people to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

MembersListRequest.title: MembersListRequest
MembersListRequest.description: One page of a members list.

MembersNumberRangeFilter.title: MembersNumberRangeFilter
MembersNumberRangeFilter.description: Inclusive bounds on a count. Set either bound, or both.

MentionableUsers.description: The people a comment on the app can mention.

branch.description: The branch, now with `status` set to `merged`.

merge_message_id.title: Merge Message Id
merge_message_id.description: ID of the message Base44 added to main's conversation to summarize the merge. Find it with [Read conversation messages](/api-reference/read-conversation-messages).

created_date.title: Created Date
created_date.description: Time the message was created, as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

created_by_email.title: Created By Email
created_by_email.description: Email of the user whose turn produced the message, or `anonymous` on a message Base44 created with no user in context.

items.title: Items

MessageQueue.description: The messages waiting to run, in the order they run.

prompt_tokens.title: Prompt Tokens
prompt_tokens.description: Tokens the model read for this message, including the conversation history it was given.

completion_tokens.title: Completion Tokens
completion_tokens.description: Tokens the model generated for this message.

credits_charged.title: Credits Charged
credits_charged.description: Credits charged for this message, or `null` if it was not billed.

date.title: Date
date.description: First day of the bucket, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. For `WEEKLY` this is the Monday, for `MONTHLY` the first of the month.

value.title: Value

clicks.title: Clicks

conversions.title: Conversions

integration_type.description: Integration type. Send it as `integration_type` in `integration_decisions`.

display_name.description: Name of the integration as shown in the builder.

status.title: Status
status.description: Connection status. Either `active`, `expired`, or `connected`.

can_keep_connected.title: Can Keep Connected
can_keep_connected.description: Whether the integration can stay connected for the new owner (`true`), or always disconnects on acceptance because it uses the current owner's own account (`false`).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How the app transfers, which is always `transfer_as_built`.

recipient_email.title: Recipient Email
recipient_email.description: Email address the invitation would go to.

existing_account_required.title: Existing Account Required
existing_account_required.description: Whether the recipient needs a Base44 account to accept, which is always `true`. They can sign up after the invitation is sent.

target_workspace.title: Target Workspace
target_workspace.description: Where the app goes by default, which is always `recipient_personal_workspace`. The recipient can choose another workspace when they accept.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: The app's secrets, without their values.

has_google_ads_account.title: Has Google Ads Account
has_google_ads_account.description: Whether the app has a Google Ads account that transfers with it (`true`) or not (`false`). The new owner has to set up its billing again, and any outstanding balance has to be settled before the recipient can accept.

name.description: Name of the app.

source_workspace_id.description: ID of the workspace the app is in now.

source_owner_id.title: Source Owner Id
source_owner_id.description: ID of the Base44 user who owns the app now.

OwnershipTransferPreflightAppSummary.title: OwnershipTransferPreflightAppSummary
OwnershipTransferPreflightAppSummary.description: Safe app summary for sender-side transfer review.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable explanation of the issue.

field.title: Field
field.description: Name of the input or app field the issue is about, or `null` when it isn't about one.

details.title: Details
details.description: Extra information about the issue, as a JSON object. It's usually empty.

can_send.title: Can Send
can_send.description: Whether the invitation can be sent (`true`) or a blocker stops it (`false`).

recipient_status.title: Recipient Status
recipient_status.description: Summary of the result. Either `can_send`, `recipient_must_sign_in_first` when the recipient doesn't have a Base44 account yet but the invitation can still be sent, `invalid_email`, or `blocked_policy` for any other blocker.

blockers.title: Blockers
blockers.description: Problems that stop the invitation from being sent. It's empty when `can_send` is `true`.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Things to know that don't stop the invitation.

transfer_package.description: What would transfer with the app, or `null` when you can't manage ownership transfers for this app.

OwnershipTransferPreflightResponse.description: Whether an ownership transfer invitation can be sent, and what would transfer with the app.

secret_name.description: Name of the app secret. Send it as `secret_name` in `secret_decisions`.

has_value.description: Whether the secret has a value that can transfer with the app (`true`) or has none (`false`).

OwnershipTransferSecretSummary.title: OwnershipTransferSecretSummary
OwnershipTransferSecretSummary.description: Safe sender-facing secret summary. Values are never included.

status.title: Status
status.description: Outcome of the request. A status of `paused` means every campaign paused, and `partial` means at least one did not.

paused_count.title: Paused Count
paused_count.description: How many campaigns this call paused.

total_count.title: Total Count
total_count.description: How many campaigns it tried to pause.

failed_count.title: Failed Count
failed_count.description: How many could not be paused. Retry the call, or pause those campaigns individually to see why.

PauseAllCampaignsResponse.title: PauseAllCampaignsResponse
PauseAllCampaignsResponse.description: Outcome of pausing every campaign on the account.

success.title: Success
success.description: Always `true`.

already_terminal.title: Already Terminal
already_terminal.description: `true` when nothing changed: the run had already ended, or it was `analyzing`. Left out when the run was paused.

PauseTestRunResult.title: PauseTestRunResult
PauseTestRunResult.description: The result of pausing a run.

status.title: Status
status.description: What happened. `paid` means the card was charged and the balance is settled. `pending_payment` means a charge was already in flight, so nothing new was attempted. `already_settled` means the invoice turned out to be paid and the account is back to normal, and `paid_recovery_incomplete` means it is paid but the account is still held. Anything else is the `state` from the summary, meaning no charge was attempted: `no_debt`, `not_recoverable`, `requires_payment_method`, `requires_payment_refresh`, or `unavailable`. Read this rather than the HTTP status, which is 200 for every one of them.

summary.description: The balance as it stands after the attempt, in the same shape [Get Google Ads workspace debt](/api-reference/get-google-ads-workspace-debt) returns. Read it back to confirm what actually changed.

PayNowResult.title: PayNowResult
PayNowResult.description: The outcome of settling the workspace's ad-spend balance.

daily.title: Daily
daily.description: One entry per day that had activity, oldest first. A day with no transactions is absent rather than zero-filled, so chart against the window you asked for rather than assuming a contiguous series.

available_currencies.title: Available Currencies
available_currencies.description: Every currency the app took money in during the window, as lowercase three-letter ISO 4217 codes. Pass one or more of these back in `currencies` to narrow the totals to a single currency.

PaymentAnalyticsResponse.title: PaymentAnalyticsResponse
PaymentAnalyticsResponse.description: An app's payment totals and its day-by-day series.

checkout_url.title: Checkout Url
checkout_url.description: Stripe-hosted page where a person enters their card details. Hand this to a human rather than trying to complete it programmatically. It expires, so fetch it when someone is ready to use it.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Stripe's ID for the session. Useful for correlating with your own logs; the API takes it nowhere.

PaymentSetupSession.title: PaymentSetupSession
PaymentSetupSession.description: A Stripe Checkout session for saving a card.

gross_revenue.title: Gross Revenue
gross_revenue.description: Everything customers paid, in the smallest unit of `currency`, so `125000` is 1,250.00 in a currency with two decimal places.

total_refunds.title: Total Refunds
total_refunds.description: Everything refunded to customers, in the smallest unit of `currency`, so `125000` is 1,250.00 in a currency with two decimal places.

total_disputes.title: Total Disputes
total_disputes.description: Everything lost to disputes customers won, in the smallest unit of `currency`, so `125000` is 1,250.00 in a currency with two decimal places. Open disputes are not counted.

net_revenue.title: Net Revenue
net_revenue.description: What the app actually kept, in the smallest unit of `currency`, so `125000` is 1,250.00 in a currency with two decimal places. It is `gross_revenue` less `total_refunds` and `total_disputes`, and it can be negative in a window with more refunds than sales.

transaction_count.title: Transaction Count
transaction_count.description: How many payments were taken in the window.

refund_count.title: Refund Count
refund_count.description: How many refunds were issued in the window.

dispute_count.title: Dispute Count
dispute_count.description: How many disputes the customer won in the window.

unique_customers.title: Unique Customers
unique_customers.description: How many distinct customers paid in the window.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency the amounts are in, as a lowercase three-letter ISO 4217 code. It is `null` when the window mixes currencies, in which case the amounts are sums across all of them and cannot be read as one currency, and also `null` when the window has no transactions at all.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Transaction time as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

action.title: Action
action.description: What this entry represents. Either `payment`, `refund`, or `dispute_lost`.

status.title: Status
status.description: Display status derived from the action. `payment` becomes `succeeded`, `refund` becomes `refunded`, and `dispute_lost` becomes `failed`. Other actions retain their action value. Defaults to an empty string.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Amount in the currency's smallest unit. Read `action` to tell an incoming payment from an outgoing refund or dispute loss. Defaults to `0`.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency code recorded with the transaction. Defaults to `usd`.

customer_id.title: Customer Id
customer_id.description: Provider customer ID, or `null` when none was recorded. Defaults to `null`.

transaction_id.title: Transaction Id
transaction_id.description: Provider transaction ID, or `null` when none was recorded. Defaults to `null`.

customer_name.title: Customer Name
customer_name.description: Customer name when provider enrichment succeeds, or `null` when unavailable. Defaults to `null`.

customer_email.title: Customer Email
customer_email.description: Customer email when provider enrichment succeeds, or `null` when unavailable. Defaults to `null`.

is_live.title: Is Live
is_live.description: Whether this entry was recorded in live mode. Defaults to `true`.

PaymentTransaction.title: PaymentTransaction
PaymentTransaction.description: A payment, refund, or lost dispute with optional customer details.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: Transactions on this page, newest first. Empty when none match or `offset` is past the end.

has_more.title: Has More
has_more.description: Whether there are more items to fetch.

PaymentTransactionsResponse.title: PaymentTransactionsResponse
PaymentTransactionsResponse.description: One page of an app's payment transactions.

status.title: Status
status.description: How Base44 handled the event. `processed` means it updated app state or recorded revenue, `acknowledged` means the event was valid but needed no action, and `ignored` means it was skipped. The Stripe endpoints also return `logged`, for an event recorded for reporting only.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the event needed no action. Present when `status` is `ignored`, and on the `acknowledged` responses that skip an event, such as a transaction that was already approved or one for a zero amount.

action.title: Action
action.description: What Base44 recorded. Present on most `processed` responses.

PaymentWebhookAck.title: PaymentWebhookAck
PaymentWebhookAck.description: What Base44 did with an inbound payment webhook event.

billing_organization_id.title: Billing Organization Id
billing_organization_id.description: ID of the billing organization the paywall was evaluated against.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: ID of the user the paywall was evaluated for.

evaluated_at.title: Evaluated At
evaluated_at.description: Time the paywall condition was evaluated, as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

app_id.title: App Id
app_id.description: ID of the app being transferred.

new_owner_email.title: New Owner Email
new_owner_email.description: Email address the transfer invitation was sent to.

status.title: Status
status.description: Either `pending`, while the invitation waits for the recipient, or `accepting`, while the recipient's acceptance is being applied.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When the invitation expires, as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format. The recipient can't accept it after that.

PendingOwnershipTransfer.title: PendingOwnershipTransfer
PendingOwnershipTransfer.description: An ownership transfer waiting for its recipient to accept it.

transfer.description: The pending transfer, or `null` when the app has none.

PendingOwnershipTransferResponse.title: PendingOwnershipTransferResponse
PendingOwnershipTransferResponse.description: The app's pending ownership transfer, if it has one.

platform.description: Platform these posts are written for.

mode.description: How to read the posts. A `series` is a sequence to publish in order, and a `selection` is a set of alternatives to pick one from.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Why the content for this platform takes the shape it does.
reasoning.example: Instagram rewards a consistent series, so these build on each other.

posts.title: Posts
posts.description: The generated posts for this platform.

plan.description: The content plan, with this post's `image_url` set.

PostImageResponse.title: PostImageResponse
PostImageResponse.description: The generated image for a post, and the plan it belongs to.

new_owner_email.title: New Owner Email
new_owner_email.description: Email address of the new owner. An invalid address comes back as a blocker.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Either `same_workspace`, to invite an owner, admin, editor, or member of the app's workspace, or `external_email`, to invite anyone. Defaults to `external_email`.

PreflightTransferRequest.title: PreflightTransferRequest
PreflightTransferRequest.description: The ownership transfer invitation to check.
